m_31b14c573583.en: Export PNG, SVG or editable .excalidraw. Shared rooms support four signed-in members. Images and external embeds are unsupported.

m_7c8ba8cf0a4e.en: Personal boards sync privately. Shared copies are visible to room members. Guest boards require Copy to account.
m_7c8ba8cf0a4e.zh-Hant: 個人白板會私人同步，共享副本則對房間成員可見。訪客白板需選擇「複製到帳號」才會加入帳號。

m_c49a19739f8e.en: Import into Personal, then choose Share a copy.
m_c49a19739f8e.zh-Hant: 請先匯入私人白板，再選擇建立共享副本。

m_f3f73e07d68a.en: Shared whiteboards are separate invitation-only copies, saved with Supabase for up to four signed-in members. Members see the drawing, public profile names, avatars, online presence and live cursors. Shared content is sent to Supabase, unlike local file tools. Only the owner manages invitations and membership. Removing a member changes channel access and invalidates the old invitation. Shared boards remain saved after everyone disconnects; the owner can delete them. Unsaved recovery copies stay on this device, isolated by account. Whiteboard and Pong share a two-active-room limit.
m_f3f73e07d68a.zh-Hant: 共享白板是獨立的邀請制副本，透過 Supabase 長期儲存，最多四位已登入成員。成員可看到繪圖、公開名稱、頭像、上線狀態與即時游標。共享內容會傳送到 Supabase，與本機檔案工具不同。只有房主能管理邀請及成員；移除成員會更新頻道存取權限，並使舊邀請失效。所有人離線後白板仍會保留，房主可刪除。未儲存的恢復副本僅保留在本機，依帳號隔離。白板與 Pong 共用兩間活躍房間的上限。

m_9dc70fce498d.zh-Hant: / 500 MB · 並非電訊商的計費流量。
